text:
zoe: Heads-up: small but reproducible surge of SSE resume retries after today's routing rollout to eu-edge. Clients saw 204 midstream -> retried -> landed on fallback route with different quota key. A few customers reported 1-2 extra token charges.

minh: Any quick traces? which routing change rolled?

zoe: route affinity pruning tightened (prune-after=20s) in canary. I dumped a couple console traces to #eng-platform-logs: proxy responded 204 when sticky lease expired, client retried and the fallback route was still mapped to legacy quota namespace.

achar: That mismatch explains the double-counting. Fallback route config wasn't normalized during the recent routes importer change. We missed a migration for quota_namespace.

lila: Repro locally: open SSE to a sticky route, force prune, proxy returns 204, client reconnects and sometimes issues two resume frames rapidly. Script attached.

```
# quick repro
curl -N "https://api.redwood/v1/sse?client=testx" &
sleep 1
curl -XPOST "https://console.internal/api/routes/prune?target=eu-edge"
sleep 1
kill -HUP $!
sleep 2
```

minh: Immediate mitigation options: 1) roll prune-after back to 5m for canary, 2) add proxy-side fallback dedupe (X-Fallback-Id), 3) normalize quota namespace at route ingestion and fastpatch existing canary routes. Rollback fastest.
achar: We should also increase resume span sampling — we were at 0.5% so very few traces. Bumping to 10% for 6h would give us visibility.

lila: Ops wants alerting: page if resume_failures > 5/min AND billing_duplicates > 0 in same minute. Otherwise SRE misses correlation.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Created change cfg-202406: routes.eu-edge.prune_after=300s, tracing.resume_sample=0.10. Rolling to 4 hosts.

zoe: Short-term plan agreed: apply cfg-202406 to canary, run a route-config migration to normalize quota_namespace, and implement X-Fallback-Id header in proxy for idempotent fallback attach. Console UX: show fallback_quota_namespace on route details with a warning if it's legacy-format.

minh: UX note: add an annotation in the rollout timeline when route-config changes are applied. We had no annotated event and correlation was manual. Product will want a small tooltip explaining implications.

achar: For the X-Fallback-Id design: proxy generates stable id per attach attempt (hash of sessionid+last_event_id+route_version) and server treats duplicate IDs within 5s as the same operation. That should stop double billing from rapid client retries.

lila: Good. Also add a migration job to rewrite legacy quota keys in route metadata; run in dry-run first. Ticketed as PROJ-1301.

minh: After cfg-202406 applied duplicate billing alerts dropped ~92% within 2 minutes. We left resume sampling at 10% for 8 hours and will revert to baseline after that.

zoe: Follow-ups: PROJ-1301 migrate-quota-keys, PROJ-1302 proxy-fallback-id, PROJ-1303 console-fallback-namespace-ui, and an operational playbook change to boost resume sampling automatically for 24h after any route-rollout.

achar: Filing PRs for proxy fix and a console mockup. Will include back-compat tests for existing quota key formats.

lila: Incident note saved. Low user impact, billing duplicates small but unacceptable. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
